title: Traa seyr
description: Ten short, simple stories about free time and hobbies on the Isle of Man.

lessons.title: Yn ree as yn aspick
lessons.summary: Grandfather Harry has played an old board game for twenty years; Mia comes to stay for the day, learns the king and the bishop, and wins with a new idea.
lessons.text:
Ta Harry Callow 70 bleeaney d'eash. Rish feed blein, t'eh er ve cloie gamman shenn er claare kerrinagh. Ta'n claare kerrinagh doo as bane, as ta reddyn beggey doo as bane er.

Jiu, ta Mia Gawne çheet dys y thie echey. She Harry shenn-ayr Mia, as t'ee 10 bleeaney d'eash. T'ee tannaghtyn ec y thie echey rish y laa.

“Nee shin cloie?” t'ee gra.

“Nee,” ta Harry gra. “Jeeagh: shoh yn ree. Ta crooin er e chione. Ta crooin er y ven echey neesht: ta'n ree as e ven reeoil. As shoh yn aspick. Ta daa aspick ec dagh cloieder. Ta'n aspick goll foddey er y chlaare.”

Ta Harry as Mia cloie. Ec y toshiaght, ta Harry goaill kerroo jeh ny reddyn eck. Agh eisht, ta smooinaght eck. T'ee goaill yn aspick echey lesh yn aspick eck.

“Smooinaght vie!” ta Harry gra. “Vel saase noa ayd?”

“Ta,” ta Mia gra. “Ta mee freayll my ree ec y slyst, as ta mee goll magh lesh ny aspickyn. She shen my saase.”

Ec y jerrey, cha nel agh kerroo jeh ny reddyn echey er y chlaare, as cha nel raad ec y ree reeoil echey. Ta Mia er chosney!

“Ta'n saase ayd feer vie,” ta Harry gra. “Nee shin cloie reesht?”

“Nee,” ta Mia gra. “Bee mee tannaghtyn ayns shoh derrey jerrey yn laa.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel Harry er ve cloie y gamman rish feed blein?
Ta. T'eh er ve cloie y gamman rish feed blein.
Vel y claare kerrinagh?
Ta. Ta'n claare kerrinagh doo as bane.
Vel crooin er y ree?
Ta. Ta crooin er e chione.
Row smooinaght vie ec Mia?
Va. Ghow ee yn aspick echey lesh yn aspick eck.
Ren Mia cosney?
Ren. Ren Mia cosney y gamman.

lessons.title: Yn eayst injil
lessons.summary: Oliver, twelve, looks at the low moon with his mother Jenny; she tells him its diameter, why its ground is not smooth, and about atomic power in the sun.
lessons.text:
S'mie lesh Oliver Kerruish y speyr. T'eh 12 bleeaney d'eash, as t'eh jeeaghyn er scannaneyn mychione y spoar.

Ec jerrey yn laa, ta Oliver as e voir, Jenny, goll mooie. Ta'n speyr doo, as ta'n eayst mooar as bane. T'ee injil 'sy speyr, faggys da'n cronk.

“Ta'n eayst feer injil,” ta Oliver gra. “Vel ee faggys dooin?”

“Cha nel,” ta Jenny gra. “T'ee foddey voin ayns y spoar. Agh tra t'ee injil, t'ee jeeaghyn mooar.”

Ta Oliver jeeaghyn er yn eayst lesh e fodreayrtan. “Cha nel yn eayst rea,” t'eh gra. “Ta towlyn mooarey urree.”

“Kiart,” ta Jenny gra. “Cha nel y thalloo urree rea. Haink claghyn veih'n spoar urree, as ren ad ny towlyn.”

“Vel fys ayd er crantessen yn eayst?” ta Oliver gra.

“Ta,” ta Jenny gra. “Ren sleih oaylleeagh towse eh. Ta crantessen yn eayst mysh kerroo jeh crantessen y thalloo. T'ad towse eh foast, dagh blein.”

“As y ghrian?” ta Oliver gra.

“Ta pooar vreneenagh ayns y ghrian,” ta Jenny gra. “Ta'n phooar vreneenagh shen cur soilshey dooin. Cha nel soilshey ec yn eayst hene: she soilshey ny greiney t'urree.”

“Vel breneenyn ayns yn eayst?” ta Oliver gra.

“Ta. Ta breneenyn ayns dagh red, as ta lectraneyn ayns dagh breneen. Ta lectraneyn feer veggey.”

Ta Oliver jeeaghyn er y speyr reesht. “Jeeagh,” t'eh gra. “Cha nel yn eayst cho injil nish.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel yn eayst injil 'sy speyr?
Ta. T'ee injil 'sy speyr, faggys da'n cronk.
Vel yn eayst rea?
Cha nel. Ta towlyn mooarey urree.
Vel crantessen yn eayst mysh kerroo jeh crantessen y thalloo?
Ta. Ren sleih oaylleeagh towse eh.
Vel pooar vreneenagh ayns y ghrian?
Ta. Ta pooar vreneenagh ayns y ghrian.
Vel lectraneyn ayns dagh breneen?
Ta. Ta lectraneyn feer veggey ayns dagh breneen.

lessons.title: Fysseree yn emshir
lessons.summary: Retired Michael in Port Erin measures the weather every day; his papers show the seasons, and when the rain increases he gives the village a warning.
lessons.text:
Ta Michael Cowell cummal ayns Purt ny h-Inshey. T'eh 66 bleeaney d'eash, as cha nel eh gobbraghey nish. Ta cliaghtey echey: t'eh çhaglym fysseree emshyragh.

Ta reddyn echey mooie son towse yn emshir. Dagh laa, t'eh jeeaghyn orroo, as t'eh screeu ny fysseree er pabyr. Ta unnid er lheh son dagh red: unnid son yn ushtey, unnid son yn aer. T'eh screeu dagh earroo lesh yn unnid echey.

Ta ram pabyr ayns y thie echey. Ta fysseree emshyragh jeh ymmodee bleeaney ayndaue. Tra t'eh jeeaghyn ayndaue, t'eh fakin dy vel kiare imbaghyn ayn: arree, sourey, fouyr as geurey. Ta'n emshir anchasley ayns dagh imbagh.

Ayns y fouyr shoh, ta Michael fakin bishaghey ayns y fliaghey. Ta'n fliaghey trome, as t'eh ny smoo trome dagh laa: she bishaghey mooar eh. Jiu, ta'n fliaghey ny smoo trome na ayns blein erbee elley.

Ta Michael cur raue da sleih y valley. T'eh screeu er y duillag echey er y voggyl: “Bee fliaghey trome ayn jiu. Freayll-jee ny paitçhyn sthie!” Ta sleih fakin y raue, as t'ad freayll sthie.

Ta kiarail ec Michael. T'eh goll dy screeu lioar veg mychione emshir Phurt ny h-Inshey. Bee ny fysseree echey ayns y lioar. “She shen my chiarail son y vlein noa,” t'eh gra.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Michael çhaglym fysseree emshyragh?
Ta. T'eh screeu ny fysseree er pabyr dagh laa.
Vel unnid er lheh son dagh red?
Ta. Ta unnid son yn ushtey, as unnid son yn aer.
Vel kiare imbaghyn ayn?
Ta. Ta arree, sourey, fouyr as geurey ayn.
Row bishaghey ayns y fliaghey?
Va. Va bishaghey mooar ayns y fliaghey ayns y fouyr.
Ren Michael cur raue da sleih y valley?
Ren. Dooyrt eh dy beagh fliaghey trome ayn.
Vel kiarail ec Michael?
Ta. T'eh goll dy screeu lioar veg mychione yn emshir.

lessons.title: Y lhiass-reireyder
lessons.summary: Dylan, manager of a children's football club in Ramsey, appoints Sean as his deputy; Sean falls on his back at his first training but carries on.
lessons.text:
Ta bluckan-coshey feer ennoil ayns Ellan Vannin. Ta club beg son paitçhyn ayns Rhumsaa, as ta Dylan Crebbin ny reireyder er. Cha nel eh cosney argid son yn obbyr: s'mie lesh eh.

Ta ram paitçhyn ayns y club nish, as ta feme ec Dylan er lhiass. Jiu, t'eh pointeil Sean Cowin myr lhiass-reireyder.

“Ta currym mooar ort nish,” ta Dylan gra rish Sean. “Bee oo freggyrtagh son ny bluckanyn as son y vagher. As tra nagh vel mee ayns shoh, bee'n lhiass-reireyder freggyrtagh son ny paitçhyn.”

“Ta mee goaill rish y currym,” ta Sean gra.

Ta ny paitçhyn çheet. Ta Sean cur bluckan da dagh paitçhey. “Ta bluckan-coshey fishigagh,” t'eh gra. “Ta feme eu er corp lajer. Roie-jee mygeayrt y vagher!”

Ta ny paitçhyn roie, as ta Sean roie maroo. Agh t'eh tuittym er e ghreeym er y vagher.

“Vel oo mie?” ta Dylan gra.

“Ta,” ta Sean gra. “Ta my ghreeym mie. Ta'n obbyr shoh ny smoo fishigagh na va mee credjal!”

Lurg shen, t'ad cloie gamman beg. Ta Sean freggyrtagh son y ghamman, as t'eh cur yn bluckan da'n chied phaitçhey.

Ec y jerrey, ta Dylan gra: “Ren oo obbyr vie. Ta'n club ennoil, as ta lhiass-reireyder mie ain nish.”

Feyshtyn:
Vel bluckan-coshey ennoil ayns Ellan Vannin?
Ta. Ta bluckan-coshey feer ennoil ayns Ellan Vannin.
Ren Dylan pointeil Sean myr lhiass-reireyder?
Ren. Ren eh pointeil Sean myr lhiass-reireyder.
Vel Sean freggyrtagh son ny bluckanyn?
Ta. T'eh freggyrtagh son ny bluckanyn as son y vagher.
Ren Sean tuittym er e ghreeym?
Ren. Ren eh tuittym er e ghreeym er y vagher.
Vel bluckan-coshey fishigagh?
Ta. Ta bluckan-coshey fishigagh.

lessons.title: Yn craishteyder
lessons.summary: Isabel, who paints for pleasure, has a model, Chloe, with long hair and white wings; the natural light comes from behind, and Chloe stretches between sittings.
lessons.text:
Ta cleayney ec Isabel Cottier son jallooyn. She peinteyr ee, agh cha nel ee cosney argid lesh: she cliaghtey eh.

Jiu, ta craishteyder çheet dys y thie eck. Chloe Creer yn ennym eck. Ta folt liauyr doo ec Chloe. Ta'n folt eck cho liauyr as y dreeym eck.

“Soie ayns shoh,” ta Isabel gra. “Ta'n soilshey najooragh mie ayns shoh. Cha mie lhiam soilshey elley son jalloo.”

Ta Isabel cur daa skian vane er dreeym Chloe. Ta ny skianyn mooarey, myr skianyn ushag.

“Jeeagh harrish yn skian,” ta'n peinteyr gra. Ta Chloe çhyndaa e kione.

Ta'n grian er cooyl Chloe, as ta'n soilshey najooragh çheet trooid y folt eck. Ta Isabel jannoo jalloo jeh'n chraishteyder. T'ee gobbraghey rish traa liauyr.

Lurg tammylt, ta Chloe gra: “Vod mee sheeyney?”

“Foddee oo,” ta Isabel gra. Ta Chloe shassoo seose, as t'ee sheeyney e laueyn as e dreeym. Eisht, t'ee soie sheese reesht, as ny skianyn er e cooyl.

Ec jerrey yn laa, ta Chloe jeeaghyn er y jalloo. Ta'n folt liauyr doo ayn, as ny skianyn bane, as y soilshey najooragh.

“Ta cleayney aym nish son jallooyn neesht!” ta'n craishteyder gra.

Feyshtyn:
Vel cleayney ec Isabel son jallooyn?
Ta. She peinteyr ee, as she cliaghtey eh.
Vel folt liauyr ec Chloe?
Ta. Ta folt liauyr doo eck.
Row skianyn er Chloe?
Va. Va daa skian vane er e dreeym.
Row'n grian er cooyl Chloe?
Va. Va'n soilshey najooragh çheet trooid y folt eck.
Ren Chloe sheeyney?
Ren. Ren ee sheeyney e laueyn as e dreeym.

lessons.title: Yn feelee aeg
lessons.summary: Molly, sixteen, writes poems in Manx; her poem is printed in English and Manx versions, and at the Cruinnaght festival the mayor gives her a prize.
lessons.text:
Ta Molly Kaneen 16 bleeaney d'eash. S'mie lhee lettyraght, as she feelee aeg ee. T'ee screeu daanyn ayns Gaelg.

Ta boodeeys beg dy sleih ta loayrt Gaelg ayns Doolish. Ta'n boodeeys shoh çhaglym dagh mee. Ayns y çhaglym, ta Molly gra daan noa. S'mie lesh y voodeeys y daan eck.

Ta Yn Chruinnaght ayn dagh blein. She feaill vooar eh son kiaull, daunse as lettyraght Vannin. Ta kiaull gooagh ayns y chruinnaght, as ta sleih goll arrane. Ta aundyr ayn son daan noa ayns Gaelg neesht.

Ta Molly cur yn daan eck dys y chruinnaght. Ta'n daan mychione y vooir as y slyst. T'ee screeu lhieggan Baarle jeh'n daan neesht, son sleih nagh vel Gaelg oc.

Lurg mee, ta screeuyn çheet. Ta Molly er chosney yn aundyr! Bee lhieggan clout jeh'n daan ayns lioar y chruinnaght: yn lhieggan Gaelg as yn lhieggan Baarle.

Er laa y chruinnaght, ta meoir Ghoolish çheet. Ta'n meoir cur yn aundyr da Molly. “Ta feelee noa ain,” t'eh gra. “Ta lettyraght ayns Gaelg bio!”

Ta Molly gra yn daan eck. Lurg shen, ta'n kiaull gooagh toshiaghey reesht. Ta lhieggan clout jeh'n daan ec Molly nish, as t'ee cur eh da'n voir eck.

Feyshtyn:
Vel Molly ny feelee aeg?
Ta. T'ee screeu daanyn ayns Gaelg.
Vel boodeeys dy sleih ta loayrt Gaelg ayns Doolish?
Ta. Ta'n boodeeys çhaglym dagh mee.
Vel kiaull gooagh ayns y chruinnaght?
Ta. Ta kiaull gooagh ayns y chruinnaght.
Ren Molly screeu lhieggan Baarle jeh'n daan?
Ren. Ren ee screeu lhieggan Baarle neesht.
Ren y meoir cur yn aundyr da Molly?
Ren. Ren meoir Ghoolish cur yn aundyr da Molly.

lessons.title: Rang Gaelg
lessons.summary: George learns Manx in an evening class; his teacher Rebecca, who studied linguistics, explains regular verbs, pronunciation and how Manx is related to Ulster Irish.
lessons.text:
Ta George Lowey 40 bleeaney d'eash. T'eh gobbraghey ayns oik ayns Doolish, agh lurg yn obbyr, t'eh ynsaghey Gaelg. She cliaghtey noa echey eh.

Ta'n rang ec Rebecca. T'ee veih Ulley ayns Nerin. Ren ee ynsaghey çhengoaylleeaght ec ollooscoill. Ta fys mooar eck er çhengaghyn.

Jiu, ta Rebecca ynsaghey breearyn. “Ta ram breearyn reiltagh ayns Gaelg,” t'ee gra. “Ta breearyn reiltagh aashagh. Agh cha nel paart jeu reiltagh: ‘hie’ as ‘haink’, son sampleyr.”

Lurg shen, t'ad goaill traa son fockley. Ta George fockley y fockle ‘çhengoaylleeaght’. Cha nel y fockley kiart.

“Leih dou,” t'eh gra.

“Ta shen mie,” ta Rebecca gra. “Ta'n fockle shen liauyr! Jean eh reesht.”

Ta George fockley yn fockle reesht, as t'eh kiart nish.

Lurg shen, ta Rebecca loayrt mychione mooinjerys ny çhengaghyn. “Ta mooinjerys eddyr Gaelg, Yernish as Gaelg Nalbin,” t'ee gra. “Ta Yernish Ulley feer faggys da Gaelg. Ta abbyrtyn ardjynagh eigsoylagh ayns Nerin, agh she Yernish Ulley yn abbyrt smoo faggys dooin.”

“Vel abbyrtyn ardjynagh ayns Gaelg neesht?” ta George gra.

“Va abbyrtyn eigsoylagh ayn: abbyrt y twoaie as abbyrt y jiass,” ta Rebecca gra.

“Leih dou, agh ta mee goll nish,” ta George gra ec y jerrey. “Bee mee ayns shoh reesht!”

Feyshtyn:
Ren Rebecca ynsaghey çhengoaylleeaght?
Ren. Ren ee ynsaghey çhengoaylleeaght ec ollooscoill.
Vel ram breearyn reiltagh ayns Gaelg?
Ta. Ta ram breearyn reiltagh ayns Gaelg.
Row'n fockley ec George kiart?
Cha row. Agh v'eh kiart nish lurg shen.
Vel mooinjerys eddyr Gaelg as Yernish?
Ta. Ta Yernish Ulley feer faggys da Gaelg.

lessons.title: Eeastagh 'sy vaie
lessons.summary: Ethan and his daughter Ava carry their gear to the rocks of Ramsey bay, catch two fish, and cook one on a gas stove with tongs.
lessons.text:
Ta Ethan Corteen as e inneen Ava goll dys baie Rhumsaa. S'mie lhieu goaill eeast. Ta reddyn trome oc, as ta'n ymmyrkey trome. Ta Ethan ymmyrkey y chooid smoo jeu.

Ta creg vooar ec y slyst. T'ad soie er y chreg, as t'ad jeeaghyn tessen y vaie. Ta'n purt tessen y vaie.

“Va ram eeastyn ayns y vaie shoh,” ta Ethan gra. “Va goaill eeast feer scanshoil son bea tarmaynagh yn ellan. Agh nish, she obbyr tarmaynagh beg eh.”

Lurg tammylt, ta Ava goaill eeast. “Jeeagh!” t'ee gra. “Eeast mooar!”

Ta Ethan goaill eeast elley. Ta ny eeastyn marroo ayns tammylt. “Cha nel ad bio nish,” ta Ava gra. “T'ad marroo.”

Ta red beg oc lesh gas ayn. Ta Ethan cur y gas er, as t'eh cur un eeast er. T'eh çhyndaa yn eeast lesh clou.

“Cur dou yn clou,” ta Ava gra. T'ee çhyndaa yn eeast lesh y clou.

Nish, ta'n eeast jeant. Ta blass mie er. “Ta blass yn eeast ny share na bee erbee 'sy thie!” ta Ava gra.

Ec y jerrey, t'ad ymmyrkey ny reddyn oc dys y thie. Ta'n eeast elley oc son bee yn laa elley.

Feyshtyn:
Va ny reddyn trome?
Va. Va'n ymmyrkey trome.
Ren ad soie er y chreg?
Ren. Ren ad soie er y chreg, as jeeaghyn tessen y vaie.
Row ny eeastyn marroo?
Va. Va ny eeastyn marroo ayns tammylt.
Ren Ethan cur y gas er?
Ren. Ren eh cur y gas er, as ren eh çhyndaa yn eeast lesh clou.
Row blass mie er yn eeast?
Va. Va blass mie er.

lessons.title: Yn keeill er y chronk
lessons.summary: Charlie and Eva walk up a hill past sheep to an old chapel surrounded by trees; it has survived from an early period, and they eat there in the free air.
lessons.text:
Ta Charlie Cringle as Eva goll seose er cronk ayns y jiass jeh'n ellan. Ta bee dy liooar oc, as ta ushtey dy liooar oc.

Ta keyrragh er y chronk. Ta paart jeh ny keyrragh bane, as ta paart jeu doo. Ta keyrrey veg jeeaghyn orroo. “Ta seyrsnys ec ny keyrragh ayns shoh,” ta Eva gra.

Er y chronk, ta keeill shenn. Ta'n cheeill çhemmit lesh biljyn. She keeill shenndeeagh ee, veih lhing feer shenn ayns shennaghys yn ellan.

“Ta'n cheeill shoh er mayrn rish ymmodee eashyn,” ta Charlie gra. “Ta ram reddyn shenndeeagh er yn ellan, agh cha nel agh beggan jeu er mayrn.”

“Ayns y lhing shen, va sleih troggal keeill er dagh cronk,” ta Eva gra.

Ta billey shenn faggys da'n cheeill. Ta fraueyn mooarey echey ayns y thalloo. Ta'n fraue mooar fo claghyn y cheeill. Ta banglane liauyr harrish y cheeill.

“Jeeagh er y vanglane shen,” ta Charlie gra. “T'eh cho liauyr as y cheeill!”

Ta Charlie as Eva soie fo'n vanglane, as t'ad gee y bee oc. Ta'n cheeill çhemmit lesh biljyn, as ta'n grian soilshaghey.

“S'mie lhiam y seyrsnys ayns shoh,” ta Charlie gra. “Ta traa dy liooar ain.”

Feyshtyn:
Row bee dy liooar ec Charlie as Eva?
Va. Va bee dy liooar oc, as ushtey dy liooar.
Row keyrragh er y chronk?
Va. Va keyrragh bane as doo er y chronk.
Vel y cheeill çhemmit lesh biljyn?
Ta. Ta'n cheeill çhemmit lesh biljyn.
Vel y cheeill er mayrn rish ymmodee eashyn?
Ta. She keeill shenndeeagh ee, veih lhing feer shenn.
Vel fraueyn mooarey ec y villey?
Ta. Ta'n fraue mooar fo claghyn y cheeill.

lessons.title: Drama veih manga
lessons.summary: A Peel drama club puts on a play made from a Japanese manga about a minister; the director, Nathan, explains the world-wide manga industry, and a magazine writes about the play.
lessons.text:
Ta club drama ayns Pheeil. Ta Jessica 15 bleeaney d'eash, as t'ee ny oltey jeh'n chlub. S'mie lhee drama.

Jiu, ta drama noa ec y chlub. Ta'n drama çheet veih manga. Nathan Kelsey yn stiureyder. T'eh soilshaghey y manga da ny aghteyryn.

“Ta manga ennoil er feie'n seihll,” ta'n stiureyder gra. “She çhynskyl dowanagh eh nish. Ta'n çhynskyl manga mooar ayns Shapaan, agh ta sleih jeeaghyn er manga ayns dagh çheer.”

Ta'n drama mychione Ard-vinishter shenn. Ta'n Ard-vinishter freayll pooar lesh armyn as lesh armee. Agh ta paitçhey aeg gra rish: “Cha nel feme ain er armyn!” Ec y jerrey, ta'n Ard-vinishter faagail ny armyn.

Ta Jessica ny Ard-vinishter 'sy drama. Ta crooin feer vooar urree, as ta arm beg ayns e laue.

“Vel y skeeal ennoil?” ta Jessica gra.

“Ta,” ta Nathan gra. “Ta'n skeeal ec y manga shoh ennoil er feie'n seihll.”

Er laa y drama, ta ram sleih çheet. Ta screeudeyr veih earishlioar çheet neesht. Lurg daa laa, ta duillag mychione y drama ayns yn earishlioar.

“Drama mie,” t'eh screeu 'syn earishlioar. “Va'n Ard-vinishter feer vie.”

Ta Jessica jeeaghyn er yn earishlioar. Ta jalloo jeh'n Ard-vinishter ayn, as ta'n arm beg ayns e laue.

Feyshtyn:
Vel y drama çheet veih manga?
Ta. Ta'n drama çheet veih manga.
Vel Nathan ny stiureyder?
Ta. Nathan Kelsey yn stiureyder.
Vel manga ny çhynskyl dowanagh?
Ta. She çhynskyl dowanagh eh nish.
Row arm ec Jessica?
Va. Va arm beg ayns e laue.
Row duillag mychione y drama ayns yn earishlioar?
Va. Va duillag mychione y drama ayns yn earishlioar.
